data.name: Dhurv
data.long_meaning: Dhurv is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhruva', which means 'fixed' or 'stable'. In Hindu mythology, Dhurv is the name of a celestial mountain and the pole star around which the heavens revolve. As such, Dhurv represents the unchanging and stable aspect of the universe.
